question: In Gujarat, the festival Makar Sankranti is celebrated as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarayan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttarayan** is the name of the festival celebrated in Gujarat during Makar Sankranti.
 
• It is one of the most significant festivals in Gujarat and is marked by the flying of kites.
 
• The festival typically occurs on the 14th of January each year and signifies the transition of the sun into the zodiac sign of Capricorn (Makara).
 
• Uttarayan is a time for social gatherings, feasts, and various cultural activities, reflecting the rich heritage of Gujarat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Makar Sankranti is celebrated across India under various names and traditions.
 
• In other parts of India, it is known as Pongal in Tamil Nadu, Lohri in Punjab, and Magh Bihu in Assam.
 
• The festival is associated with harvest and is a time for farmers to give thanks for the bounty of the season.
 
• The day also marks the beginning of the auspicious phase of the Sun's journey northward (Uttarayan), which is considered favorable for spiritual practices and rituals.
